WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'Web shop' ELSE region END AS region_line FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id <> 999),
sk AS (SELECT store_key, c.region_line FROM dim_store s JOIN cur c USING(store_id)),
fy AS (SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter=3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')),
sales AS (SELECT fy.fiscal_year, sk.region_line, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fy ON fy.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN sk USING(store_key)),
rets AS (SELECT fy.fiscal_year, sk.region_line, -r.refund_net AS amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fy ON fy.calendar_date=r.return_date JOIN sk USING(store_key)),
agg AS (SELECT region_line, fiscal_year, sum(amt) net_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT a.region_line AS region, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, round(a.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26, round(b.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25, round(100*(a.net_sales/b.net_sales-1),1) AS growth_pct
FROM agg a JOIN agg b ON a.region_line=b.region_line AND b.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.region_line='Web shop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1
